the term "agile" has been defined and classified in a systematic and consistent manner.

agile software development methods are lightweight, iterative, incremental and adaptive approaches that focus on people and communication, and they are based on the assumption that software development is a learning process.

agile methods are a group of software development methods that are based on the following four principles: 1) customer satisfaction through early and continuous delivery of valuable software; 2) working software is the primary measure of progress; 3) face-to-face communication is the most efficient and effective method of conveying information within a development team; and 4) sustainable development - able to maintain a constant pace indefinitely.
